newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns AAA to CL Asset Management's notes.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AAA to CL Asset Management's notes.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Monday that it had assigned provisional AAA ratings to CL Asset Management KK's aggregate 20 billion yen of notes.
The aggregate 20 billion yen Series One notes are secured by a pool of equipment-lease receivables of approximately 34.9 billion yen originated by Central Leasing Co Ltd, S&P said in a statement.
The lease receivables are purchased by CL Asset in accordance with the Japanese law for regulation of business relating to specified claims, it said.
